inner.title: wait for the definition
inner.body: the si executive order binds federal agencies, and its legal definition is due around november 28. founders renaming their startup now are guessing in public.

inner.title: audit your own claims
inner.body: search your site for superintelligent, guaranteed and never, then cut them. the ftc can already act on deceptive ai marketing, new name or not.

inner.title: keep an incident log
inner.body: a one-page log: the date, what broke, what you changed. the si accord asks for four layers of controls, and you can't name last week's bug.

inner.title: verify before you pivot
inner.body: check the company's own site before you copy a big rename. musk said spacexsi on october 4, and a day later its site still said spacexai.

inner.title: publish original data
inner.body: share build logs, teardowns and numbers only you have. us searchers clicked a regular link 8% of the time with an ai summary, versus 15% without.
